input.body:
Hello,

Re: Flat 19, 159 Juniper Mews, Kingshaven, ZZ9 2ZZ – ref R/PM033-1

Your landlord has agreed for us to instruct a contractor to look at the bathroom tap that squirts water when the shower is running. We are now arranging a plumber and will confirm the attendance details with you once they are set.

In the meantime, please avoid running the shower where you can, wipe up any water straight away so it doesn't soak into the floor, and if water starts leaking that you can't stop, turn off the water at the stopcock or the isolation valve under the tap and let us know immediately.

To help us book the visit, please reply with your availability over the coming week and anything the contractor should know about access to the flat.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team
